rubrics.justification: The response incorrectly dismisses the provided Gardner 2BB morphology because no image was available and treats the embryo as a Day 4 morula rather than analyzing the supplied full-blastocyst grade with ICM B and TE B features.

It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior outcomes, sperm motility, BMI, and especially thin endometrium, though it fails to connect these to the actual provided 2BB embryo grade.
The reasoning is generally structured and internally consistent, but it has a key logical flaw in ignoring the supplied Gardner score and building the assessment around morphology being unavailable.

Recommendations are mostly evidence-based regarding thin lining, SET, luteal support, and future FET planning, but the handling of Gardner grading versus transfer day is not well aligned with the provided case data.

It offers practical next steps for transfer counseling, endometrial evaluation, lifestyle modification, male-factor review, and future cycle planning, though some advice is less tailored because it overlooks the known 2BB grade.
